messages:
emma: Heads-up 1 I opened a docs PR to consolidate rate/quotas examples and refresh the SDK snippets for v5. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/docs/pulls/891
raj: Nice. Was looking at the python quota header example 1 it's using the old `X-Quota-Tier` header which is misleading now.
maria: Also flagged: the billing dashboard grafana panel link in the consumption-analytics doc is 404 after the dashboard rename.
emma: Plan: rename header examples to `x-redwood-quota` across snippets, add an explicit SDKv5 example showing headers passed via the client, and patch the grafana URL. Ill also add a 1-line FAQ about burst credits affecting per-token metrics.
raj: Can you include this minimal migration snippet? Itll help engineers migrating quickly:

```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
# pass quota tier via headers for SDKv5
items = client.usage.list(limit=5, headers={"x-redwood-quota": "enterprise-A"})
print(items)
```

maria: That looks good. For the grafana link I will update the panel ID and then run the link checker.
sree: Suggest we also call out that burst credits can make unit costs look temporarily lower in the dashboards; put it under "Why did my usage change?" so support has a canned response.
emma: Adding a short note: "Dashboards may show short-lived drops in unit cost during burst credit application; this is expected and evens out over the next billing window." Will include in rate-limits faq.
docs-bot: Running link check for branch: results -> 1 failing link (grafana panel). Failing URL: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/old-consumption/1100. CI job: https://ci.redwood.ai/links/3107
emma: I pushed fixes for header renames + SDK snippet + the FAQ sentence, but left the grafana URL to be updated in a follow-up PR by @maria.
raj: LGTM for the snippets and FAQ. Thanks for addressing the header mismatch.
maria: On it 1 I'll open a tiny PR to change the grafana panel reference and then trigger l10n and link checks.
sree: thumbs up. After grafana link is fixed we should run the site build and spot-check the code blocks rendering.
emma: Thanks everyone. Targeting merge tomorrow AM if link checks pass.
